headline: Pertalite Price Stagnant as World Oil Surges, Economist: Inflation Will Be Uncontrolled If Prices Rise
summary: The Indonesian government has kept the selling price of Pertalite fuel at Rp 10,000 while world oil prices surge. An economist said uncontrolled inflation could follow if the price were raised.
why: Pertalite is a subsidised fuel grade in Indonesia, so government price decisions affect state budget costs and domestic inflation.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
